summary: Freight Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the formalization of agentic AI across its organization to accelerate its software-first transformation. The filing is a routine disclosure of operational developments, with no mention of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate event. No deal terms, financial figures, or structural changes are provided. The registrant is the issuer reporting ordinary business progress. As a non-US issuer, the 6-K is equivalent to a US Form 8-K for material events, but no special situation is identified.
